data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Afra', which means 'free' or 'unbound'. In the Islamic context, the name 'Afreedeh' symbolizes being free from sin and being righteous. The name Afreedeh carries the meaning “Pure, Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afreedeh usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
